families.purpose: Base readable ground and horizon mass
families.requiredVariants: flat, slope, steep, distant/HLOD; transition edges
families.look: Compressed Stonehold highland mass: stepped basalt benches, fault-tilted plateaus, iron-brown slopes, ash-dusted flats, distant HLOD as darker stacked plates. No cartoon mesas, no alpine snow default.

families.requiredVariants: intact, fractured, weathered, wet; far reduction
families.look: Layered basalt pavement with columnar joints, soot in fractures, wet sheen only in cracks, weathered iron staining. Grounded PBR rock, not lava.

families.purpose: Soil, loam, tilled and compacted ground
families.requiredVariants: dry, damp, disturbed, compacted
families.look: Iron-rich quarry soil and compacted loam: rust-brown fines, basalt grit, dry crust, damp darker pockets, disturbed pick marks, wagon-compacted paths. Realm-wide soil, not only quarry spoil.

families.requiredVariants: fine gravel, scree, talus, compact trail
families.look: Angular basalt gravel and iron-stained scree, compact quarry trail, loose talus fans. No river-rounded decorative pebbles.

families.requiredVariants: short, worn, wet/dry, sparse transition
families.look: Drought turf over iron soil: short dun-olive blades, worn quarry-edge paths, sparse transition into ash. Not lush meadow.

families.requiredVariants: damp, saturated, cracked, tracked
families.look: Iron-silt drainage mud: cracked dry pans, saturated runoff channels, boot and cart tracks, ochre staining. Not tropical swamp.

families.purpose: Cold ground and safe/unsafe ice read
families.requiredVariants: snow crust, drift, exposed ice, melt edge; non-specular cue
families.look: High-pass Stonehold rime: soot-dusted snow crust, wind-carved drifts against basalt, dull unsafe ice with ash grit, melt edges showing iron soil. Readable without relying on specular glare.

families.requiredVariants: ash, cooled slag, glass face, active-fracture edge without emission dependency
families.look: Cooled forge-slag and volcanic-glass ground: charcoal ash, vesicular slag cakes, dull obsidian faces, fracture edges readable with value not glow.

families.purpose: Exterior civic, ruin and settlement paving
families.requiredVariants: intact, worn, broken, edge/corner
families.look: Practical basalt sett paving with iron clamps, soot-worn centers, broken corners, quarry-cut edges. Not dwarf rune roads.

families.purpose: Dry shore, shallows and submerged bed
families.requiredVariants: dry, wet, shallow, deep-value boundary
families.look: Braided iron-shore: dark wet basalt cobbles, ochre silt shallows, dry pale crust, deep-value water boundary without fake transparency tricks.

families.requiredVariants: still, flow, shallow, deep, low-motion/static fallback
families.look: Cold mineral water: still quarry pools, slow braided flow, shallow iron tint, deep charcoal basins, static low-motion fallback tiles. No tropical turquoise.

families.requiredVariants: straight, inner/outer curve, inlet, drop, dry fallback
families.look: Worked and natural banks: straight cut channel, inner/outer basalt curves, inlet notch, small drop, dry fallback lip. Foam as thin mineral scum, not cartoon spray.

families.requiredVariants: linear, patch, corner, multi-surface junction
families.look: PBR decal patches blending basalt-to-soil, soil-to-ash, paving-to-gravel. Soft dirt breakup, not painted stripes.

families.purpose: Explain runoff, wash, cracks and deposition
families.requiredVariants: flowline, puddle rim, sediment, erosion scar
families.look: Iron-stained flowlines, puddle rims, sediment fans, erosion scars on basalt. Weather history, not VFX particles.

families.requiredVariants: waterline, drip, splash, damp patch; opaque fallback
families.look: Dark waterlines, drip tracks, splash fans, damp patches on stone and soil. Opaque wetness, no screen-space-only tricks.

families.purpose: Road, foot, wheel and work wear
families.requiredVariants: foot, cart, drag, quarry/mine, construction
families.look: Boot ruts, cart ruts, drag scars, quarry-work scuffs on iron soil and paving. Readable at gameplay distance.

families.purpose: Scorch, impact, rubble and repair read
families.requiredVariants: old/new damage, repaired, battle-safe, low-clutter
families.look: Old soot scorch, fresh impact chips, sparse rubble, patched stone. Battle-safe low clutter, no gore.

families.purpose: Non-color route, boundary and hazard cue
families.requiredVariants: route edge, hazard, objective-safe marker, disabled/reduced-effects
families.look: Carved basalt kerbs, iron studs, stacked stone cairns, hazard notches. Shape-first, not color-only paint.

families.requiredVariants: young, mature, ancient/landmark where approved, damaged, stump, far proxy
families.look: Stonehold ironwood: soot-dark plated bark, compressed branching, sparse mineral-dusted needle/leaf clusters, wind-pruned crowns. Not pine-forest default, not Eldergrove lush canopy. Include 1.8m human scale ghost.

families.requiredVariants: sapling, juvenile, wind-pruned, dead; clustered instancing
families.look: Stunted iron saplings and wind-pruned juveniles in rock pockets, clustered instances, dead grey stems. Same bark language as canopy.

families.requiredVariants: short/tall, sparse/dense, wet/dry; reduced-motion mesh
families.look: Short dun-olive clumps, sparse iron-soil grass, denser wet-channel blades, dry straw. Reduced-motion static clumps. Not prairie wheat.

families.requiredVariants: planted, growing, mature, harvested/stubble, damaged
families.look: Hardy terrace grain on quarry-edge plots: ash-dusted stalks, iron-brown heads, planted rows, stubble after harvest, storm-damaged lean. Practical farm, not golden fantasy wheatfield.

families.purpose: Common plants and herb harvest sources
families.requiredVariants: non-harvestable, harvestable, depleted, regrown; at least three silhouette groups
families.look: Three distinct hardy herbs in basalt crevices: ironleaf rosette, soot-sage spike, mineral-crusted succulent. Harvestable vs cut-depleted vs regrown readable by silhouette.

families.purpose: Flower accents and approved harvest sources
families.requiredVariants: sparse patch, focal cluster, harvestable/depleted; no color-only interaction
families.look: Restrained slagbloom: small iron-brown and muted forge-amber florets, sparse patches and one focal cluster. Depleted is cut stems, not greyed color only.

families.purpose: Cover edge, field boundary and scrub
families.requiredVariants: low/high, sparse/dense, clipped/wild, damaged
families.look: Compressed iron-leaf shrubs, clipped farm hedges, wild wind-scrub, damaged broken crowns. Cover-readable masses.

families.requiredVariants: reed, broadleaf, submerged, dry remnant; reduced-motion
families.look: Iron-stained runoff reeds, few broadleaf water plants, submerged stems, dry straw remnants. Reduced-motion clumps.

families.requiredVariants: small, large, sparse clump, damaged
families.look: Mineral ferns at cave mouths and damp basalt: leathery dull-green fronds with ash dust, damaged brown tips. Not tropical rainforest ferns.

families.purpose: Wall, ruin, trunk and hanging growth
families.requiredVariants: wall, ground, hanging, dead/dry; collision-free
families.look: Soot-vines gripping basalt and ironwood: wall mats, ground runners, hanging dry strands, dead wiry remnants. Collision-free dressing, not mesh-eating ivy.

families.requiredVariants: crust, shelf, cap cluster, harvest/depleted; non-emissive base
families.look: Non-emissive cave fungi: mineral crust, basalt shelf brackets, iron-brown cap clusters. Harvest vs depleted by missing caps, not glow.

families.requiredVariants: moss mat, crust lichen, wet biofilm, mineral crust
families.look: Dry lichen maps, thin soot-moss mats, wet biofilm in seeps, mineral crust. Age the stone; do not paint magic moss.

families.purpose: Root walls, ramps, arches and shoreline shelves
families.requiredVariants: ground, wall, buttress, bridge/ramp, broken; traversal review
families.look: Ironwood roots gripping fault rock as buttresses and broken ramps. Compressed, practical, not Eldergrove living architecture or fairy root bridges.

families.purpose: Fallen logs, branches, stumps and decomposing wood
families.requiredVariants: log, stump, branch scatter, hollow, wet/dry, harvestable/depleted
families.look: Soot-charred ironwood logs, stumps, branch scatter, hollow trunks, wet dark vs dry grey. Harvestable pile vs depleted chips.

families.requiredVariants: available/targeted/depleted/absent
families.look: Gameplay-readable deadwood node: stacked ironwood with tool-cut faces, targeted chip marks, depleted scatter, absent empty socket. Same material as deadwood family.

families.requiredVariants: available/targeted/depleted/regrowing/locked
families.look: Slagbloom harvest node matching flower family: available cluster, targeted cut, depleted stems, small regrow buds, locked iron-caged specimen. Silhouette states, not color-only.

families.requiredVariants: available/targeted/depleted/regrowing/locked
families.look: Cave fungi harvest node: available shelves, targeted knife marks, depleted scars, regrowing nubs, locked grate. Non-emissive.

families.requiredVariants: available/targeted/depleted/regrowing/locked
families.look: Herb harvest node matching ironleaf/soot-sage/succulent groups with available, targeted, depleted, regrowing, locked states.

families.requiredVariants: available/damaged/felled/stump/regrowing/locked
families.look: Ironwood harvest tree: standing available, axe-damaged, felled log, stump, sapling regrow, locked marked bole. Include 1.8m scale ghost.

families.requiredVariants: small/medium/large, fractured, embedded, far proxy
families.look: Fractured basalt boulders and broken rafts: small/medium/large, embedded in soil, far proxy masses. Realm-wide language extending Slagfall irregular/broken fracture rafts, not copying franchise rocks.

families.requiredVariants: pebble, small, medium; clustered/instanced; wet/dry
families.look: Angular basalt pebble-to-fist scatter, clustered instances, wet darker, dry dusty. Dressing only.

families.requiredVariants: base, mid, top, inner/outer corner, transition, HLOD
families.look: Diagonal fault-slab cliffs: base talus contact, mid plate, top lip, inner/outer corners, HLOD. Impassable read without color-only stripes. Include 1.8m scale ghost.

families.requiredVariants: walkable, non-walkable, overhang, drop edge; non-color cue
families.look: Undercut extraction ledges: walkable lip with scuffed soil, non-walkable slope, deep overhang, drop edge with shape cue. Do not lock meters.

families.requiredVariants: fine, coarse, collapse fan, worked spoil
families.look: Talus apron and collapse fans: fine, coarse, worked spoil distinct from natural fan.

families.requiredVariants: open, collapsed, gated, wet/dry, far silhouette
families.look: Gallery-mouth cave thresholds: open dark maw, collapsed rubble mouth, simple iron-gated, wet seepage vs dry soot, far silhouette. Include 1.8m scale ghost. Not a building.

families.requiredVariants: straight, bend, slope, junction, choke, transition
families.look: Worked-and-natural basalt tunnels: straight bore, bend, slope, three-way junction, choke, interior-to-gallery transition. Modular kit look, no invented nav widths.

families.purpose: Cave chamber, lair and objective space
families.requiredVariants: small/medium/hero chamber, entrance/descent/lair sockets, HLOD
families.look: Stonehold cavern chambers: small pocket, medium hall, hero fault chamber with entrance, descent, and lair sockets as empty volumes. Mineral walls, no interior furniture, no baked VFX.

families.requiredVariants: common/rare visual strata, exposed/cut, depleted-looking noninteractive
families.look: Non-interactive iron and dark-copper strata in basalt cuts. Common dull band vs rare denser inclusions. Depleted-looking but clearly noninteractive dressing.

families.requiredVariants: available, targeted, depleted, regenerating/locked; tool contact
families.look: Interactive ore node: exposed iron-ore mass with tool-contact face, targeted chip, depleted socket, regenerating crust, locked clamp. Readable without emission.

families.requiredVariants: available, targeted, depleted, regenerated/locked
families.look: Quarryable basalt block node with wedge marks, targeted split, depleted pit, regenerated face, locked timber brace.

families.requiredVariants: cluster, seam, monolith, broken; readable emission-off
families.look: Stonehold mineral crystals: clustered shards, wall seam, small monolith, broken scatter. Restrained forge-amber inner fracture that remains readable with emission off. Not marketplace gems, not lava crystals.

families.requiredVariants: dormant, available, active, depleted, corrupted only if narrative-approved
families.look: Interactive crystal node: dormant dull, available readable facets, active inner amber without particle spray, depleted hollow geode. No corrupted variant invented. Emission-off still reads as crystal.

families.requiredVariants: supports, tailings, spoil, track, winch base, safety barriers
families.look: Slagfall/quarry dressing: timber/iron supports, tailings piles, spoil, rail-less track beds, winch base, simple safety barriers. Practical extraction, not dwarf mine cartoon.

families.requiredVariants: available/targeted/depleted/regrowing/locked
families.look: Gameplay derivative of mineable ore node with the same iron-ore language and state tiles.

families.requiredVariants: available/targeted/depleted/regrowing/locked
families.look: Gameplay derivative of stone mineable node with the same basalt-block language and state tiles.

families.requiredVariants: dormant/available/targeted/depleted/locked; emission-off read
families.look: Gameplay derivative of magical crystal node. Emission-off readability required in every state.
